title: Quickstart Visuals: Shared screenshot style system and sanitization pipeline
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Quickstart guides and product docs currently contain inconsistent screenshots (different crops, inconsistent brand overlays, occasional exposure of customer data in examples). This causes brand drift and increases localization and maintenance burden.

Goal: Define a single, automated pipeline and shared style system that produces brand-consistent, privacy-safe, localization-ready screenshots and illustrative assets for quickstarts, docs, and release notes. The pipeline should output production-ready PNG/SVG assets plus metadata used by docs and Console onboarding flows.

Scope: First iteration covers web Console flows used in quickstarts and docs (login, create-model, deploy, simple chat). Devices: desktop (1200x700), tablet (900x600), mobile (390x844). Must produce localized variants for en, fr, de, ja, ko, es and support RTL layout checks.

Non-goals: UI redesign; one-off marketing hero images (handled by Brand team).
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens + Figma components for screenshot overlays and device frames approved and published in 'Onboarding UI Kit'
Pipeline can take a sanitized DOM snapshot + metadata and output cropped images for three device sizes with consistent padding, background, and brand overlays
Automated redaction step removes or masks PII patterns (emails, API keys, IPs, UUIDs) configurable per-route
Localization harness generates locale-specific screenshots and flags text overflow or truncation issues; RTL layouts validated
All assets include a machine-readable metadata JSON (filename, route, locale, component-version, alt-text) and follow the naming convention: onboarding_{route}_{device}_{locale}_{variant}.png
CI job runs visual QA checks and fails when masking rules are not applied or when alt-text is missing
Documentation for product writers and engineers: how to request new routes, override masks, and required metadata fields
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with Eng infra, Docs, and Product. Agreed to prioritize quickstart flows and to reuse existing brand device frames from Brand repo.
2026-03-04: Prototype in Figma created for overlay tokens (corner radius, shadow, caption strip). Link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/onboarding-ui-kit
2026-03-06: Eng spike completed for DOM snapshot approach — using Puppeteer to capture deterministic screenshots with stable fonts. Spike PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3281

2026-03-08: Decision: perform redaction in two passes — (1) syntactic masking via regex rules (emails, keys, UUIDs), (2) visual blur for unstructured sensitive regions. PM requested configurable allow-list for demo accounts.
2026-03-10: Localization lead (Sofia Martinez) reviewed flow; requested max-length rules for French and German; added 'truncate-warning' flag generation for assets where text overruns.
2026-03-12: Accessibility review: require alt-text for each generated image and a short description for screen readers (stored in metadata). Added CI blocker if alt-text empty.

2026-03-14: Current: design tokens PR in review, image pipeline PoC running on staging, initial CI visual tests green for three sample routes. Next: finalize redaction regex set and add RTL device test harness.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: conservative masking reduces contextual fidelity for demos; PM accepted a small set of demo allow-listed accounts. Long-term: evaluate synthetic demo data to avoid masking. Plan to hand off brand frames to Brand team for single-source-of-truth.
